# Getmore OS

> 24/7 AI Receptionist, high-intent lead generation, and custom operational AI automations for high-ticket service businesses across the US, UK, Australia, and Canada. Plans from $500 to $2,000/mo.

## Key facts
- Website: https://getmoreos.in/
- Serves: United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada
- Price range: $500 – $2,000 / month (Fully customized per client)
- Primary Conversion Goal: Schedule 15-minute Strategy & Live AI Demo Call

## Core Capabilities & Services
- 24/7 AI Voice Receptionist (Instant Ring 1 pickup, human-like voice, direct calendar scheduling)
- High-Intent Local Lead Generation (Exclusive buyer acquisition pipelines)
- Operational AI Automations (Automated 2-way SMS reminders, quote follow-ups, no-show reactivation, 5-star review generation, CRM sync)

## Packages
- Package 1: AI Receptionist OS ($500/mo) — Zero missed calls, 24/7 smart scheduling, missed-call SMS text back
- Package 2: Growth OS ($1,250/mo) — Lead Generation + AI Receptionist to acquire and convert high-ticket leads
- Package 3: Autonomous Scale OS ($2,000/mo) — Lead Gen + AI Receptionist + Full Operational AI Automations Suite
